intro.html: I'm Div. I'm a Principal PM at Care.com in Austin — consumer growth across six care marketplaces, after building the Camps & Activities vertical 0–1.
Before that I was first PM at Gloco.ai, and I co-founded Deliverend and Aggressively Organic (100k+ orders).
People always tell me that psychology and math are two ends of the spectrum. To me they are closer than ever.

body.html: Current: Principal PM, Consumer Growth. Previously Product Lead, Business Growth (Daycares, Senior Assisted Living, Camps & Activities).
Focus: product strategy, supply growth, demand growth, conversion, activation.
Consumer growth: 27M+ seekers, 650k+ providers, across six marketplaces (childcare, senior care, adult care, pet care, housekeeping, tutoring).
First PM hire at a scale-up. Unblocked order throughput, then built an AI-first regulatory compliance product for global sellers after ChatGPT launched.

items: Helped Flatfee raise $1.3m for marketing and product/eng.
Core product engine for 5,000 enterprise customers and $2.2m annual revenue.
820 new enterprise customers, 20% lower CAC, $300k direct revenue.
15% revenue lift from an AI support tool.
Owned the core marketplace and fulfillment portal (~$150k monthly order volume).
Stripe and Kangxin API integrations; China trademark partnership with Kangxin.

body.html: Co-founded the Uber of logistics. B2C: deliveries and escrow between Facebook Marketplace buyers and sellers. B2B: a vertically scalable fleet for brick-and-mortar.
Raised $2.2m, 100k deliveries, 1.5k drivers in 4 cities. Built B2C and B2B 0–1 (web + two mobile apps) and the data pipelines.
Press: Yahoo Finance, Wish-TV, TechPoint.
